purpose: Configuration and separation policy for the MIDDAY graded-DCA stream: a single 12:30 PM ET live Robinhood execution (cron a6239dae, run_type='midday_dca_live', trades=true) on account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER>. It uses the SAME afternoon 0x-to-8x ladder and $2 base, the same active universe (excluding the whole-share tickers BYDDY and RVII), the same confidence rule, and the same balanced $2-base budget policy. It is INDEPENDENT of, and never valid evidence for, the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b).
confidence_rule: A candidate whose price/drop passes the ladder is auto-bought ONLY when the intraday trend can be validated (>= trend_min_bars usable intraday bars at or before the 12:30 decision time). If price/drop passes but the intraday trend cannot be validated, the run must NOT auto-buy; it classifies the candidate as execution_status='manual_review_candidate'. There is no loosened trend-unavailable execution path.
live_execution_enabled_note: SHIPS ENABLED, unlike market_open_dca.json and intraday_dca.json ('SHIPS DISABLED'). The 12:30 midday stream (a6239dae) is one of the currently-functioning live executions, so this key records the live state that was previously only implicit in MiddayConfig.live_execution_enabled's inherited True default. It is stated explicitly here so the value is auditable and so load_midday_config() can distinguish 'config says live' from 'config could not be read' -- the latter now falls back to shadow mode rather than inheriting True. The value is surfaced on every run_state as live_execution_enabled.

live_task.name: Weekday 12:30 PM midday DCA live Robinhood execution
live_task.note: Live Robinhood execution using account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER> (Alpaca stays read-only for validation/context). Uses a true intraday trend window at 12:30. Subject to the confidence_rule: no auto-buy when the intraday trend cannot be validated.

raw_input_generation.summary: Before invoking any saved runner such as /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/a6239dae/run_midday_live.sh or midday_live_runner.py, the scheduled 12:30 task MUST create the same-day raw/ directory and persist all required raw inputs for that same-day run. Do NOT assume raw/quotes.json or historicals already exist from a prior run.
required_inputs: raw/quotes.json (or clearly named quote batches normalized into raw/quotes.json)
historical/trend files needed for the 60-minute trend check
raw_input_generation.run_date_arg: If the runner requires a RUN_DATE_ET argument, pass the current America/New_York date as YYYYMMDD.
raw_input_generation.data_sources: Generate raw inputs from Robinhood (get_equity_historicals 5-minute and daily bars, get_equity_quotes) for every active ticker; Robinhood is the primary signal source for this slot. If Robinhood fails as a whole (listed in source_errors, absent, or no scored ticker fresh for the slot), switch the entire ordinary universe to the explicitly labeled, prefetched yfinance fallback; a single ticker gap remains that ticker's provider error. Do not use the Finance connector as the primary source.
raw_input_generation.bounded_recovery: If raw input generation fails once, perform ONE bounded recovery attempt with the alternate approved data source path, then stop.

state_file_guarantee.summary: The 12:30 scheduled run MUST always write run_state.json, run_summary.json, and latest_midday_run.json under the midday root even when no orders are placed or execution is blocked.

missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs_state.when: If raw inputs are missing, malformed, stale, or not generated, write a valid scheduled midday run_state with these fields.
missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs_state.missing_inputs_field: Include a compact list of missing files or failed data sources.

state_file_guarantee.evidence_meaning: This failure-state artifact is valid proof that the 12:30 scheduled task FIRED, but it is NOT order or fill evidence.
state_file_guarantee.no_silent_escalation: Do NOT escalate without writing this state file unless the workspace itself is unavailable.

They remain prior-allocation / top-up context only.
must_not: MUST NOT satisfy raw quote or historical input requirements.
MUST NOT be copied into the scheduled evidence stream.
MUST NOT be counted as proof that the 10:30 scheduled task ran.

sizing_ladder.name: midday_0x_to_5x
sizing_ladder.tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).
sizing_ladder.separation_note: This is the SAME shared $2-base 0x-to-8x live ladder used by all live streams (morning 10:30, midday 12:30, afternoon 3:20; config/sizing_ladder.json). Max per order is 8x * $2 = $16. The former morning-only 0x-to-3x ladder is historical/superseded as of 2026-07-10.

budget_ledger.shared_pool_note: POOLING FIX (Geoff, confirmed 2026-08-02: 'caps aren't pooled the way the target design intends -- fix it'). Raised from the old isolated per-stream half-share (90.0/450.0) to the SAME shared Normal-tier ceiling every stream draws from (near_close_dca.BUDGET_TIERS[0], mirrored in config/budgets.json and config/morning_dca.json). artifact_paths.cap_seed_roots below (previously absent -- midday had NO cross-stream cap visibility at all) now spans every sibling stream so this ledger sees the whole day's/week's cross-stream spend. As with morning, this does not add dynamic Elevated/High-volatility/Stress escalation to the midday slot itself -- only the 3:30 final run escalates, from its fuller same-day view; midday shares the flat Normal $180/$900 floor and is therefore only ever more conservative than the true escalated-day ceiling, never less.
budget_ledger.separation_note: Superseded 2026-08-02 by shared_pool_note above: the midday ledger's CAP is now the same shared $180/day, $900/week ceiling every stream draws from, not an isolated 90/450 half-share. It remains a separate ledger OBJECT from the morning ledger and the afternoon StrategyState / BUDGET_TIERS ledger (different code path, different persisted file, own namespace) -- but the ceiling it is checked against is shared, not independent.

top_up_rule.description: Morning/manual prior same-day buys are prior-allocation context only; they never block the midday run. The midday run tops up only when it is buying into a lower price. The identical guard applies to the morning, midday, afternoon, and manual override same-day fills: every later run buys only max(0, desired_amount - prior_same_day_amount), and only when the current decision price is strictly below the prior same-day reference price.
top_up_rule.reference_price_preference: The prior same-day reference price is resolved in this order: the run's logged target_price, then decision_price, then the confirmed average_fill_price (from orders.csv or a manual override's filled_orders.csv). A missing reference price (none of the three available) means no automatic top-up: the candidate is flagged top_up_manual_review (manual_review_candidate) at $0.
rules: No earlier same-day allocation for the ticker -> normal allocation (buy the full midday desired amount).

Earlier allocation exists and the midday decision price is strictly below the earlier run's reference price -> buy only the incremental dollar difference max(0, midday desired - amount already bought); $0 if that is <= 0.
Earlier allocation exists but the midday price is not below the reference price -> buy $0.
Earlier amount known but no comparable price (missing prior reference or current midday price) -> conservative $0 with top_up_manual_review flagged (manual_review_candidate).
top_up_rule.prior_allocation_sources: Market-open (9:35) live fills under market_open_dca, morning live and manual runs under the morning-live root, plus MANUAL missed-morning 10:30 recovery artifacts under morning_dca/manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false); scheduled afternoon runs are ignored as prior context. Midday's own scheduled runs and its manual override reruns (manual_reruns/) are eligible prior context for the afternoon guard only. Manual missed-morning recovery artifacts are prior-allocation / top-up context only and never scheduled evidence.

artifact_paths.cap_seed_roots_note: ADDED 2026-08-02 (see budget_ledger.shared_pool_note). Previously midday had NO cap_seed_roots at all, so its budget ledger was fully isolated with zero visibility into any other stream's same-day spend -- unlike prior_allocation_roots above, which only feeds the PER-TICKER top-up guard's reference price, never the daily/weekly cap. This list is every sibling stream, including midday's own root (so a restart/retry still seeds from its own prior fills) and final_manual_review (the out-of-tree manual final-buy override root), so the shared ceiling in budget_ledger above is genuinely pooled.
artifact_paths.manual_recovery_note: The 12:30 midday run MUST scan /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/morning_dca/manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* for same-day MANUAL missed-morning 10:30 recovery artifacts (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false). They are prior-allocation / same-day top-up context ONLY: the midday run buys max(0, desired - prior) and only when its decision price is strictly below the prior reference price. They are NEVER midday scheduled evidence, never proof the 10:30 scheduled task ran, and never counted in scheduled reliability, fill counts, slippage, cost basis, or watchdog confirmation. See config/morning_dca.json:manual_missed_run_recovery.
artifact_paths.manual_rerun_note: Manual override fills are recorded under manual_reruns/**/run_state.json and filled_orders.csv (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true). They are EXCLUDED from scheduled evidence, slippage, reliability, fill counts, watchdog confirmation, and cost basis, and are used ONLY as prior-allocation context for the same-day top-up guard (they affect the afternoon 3:20 PM top-up eligibility, not any scheduled metric). Manual override reruns are not part of prior_allocation_roots for the midday run itself because they post-date the 12:30 PM decision; the afternoon guard folds them in via the midday root.
artifact_paths.manual_midday_recovery_note: manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* holds MANUAL missed-12:30 midday recovery artifacts placed by hand after a missed or failed 12:30 scheduled midday run (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false). Example: /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/midday_dca/manual_recovery/20260720_1259ET (Jul 20 2026, placed at 12:59 ET after the 12:30 scheduled midday run failed; fills AAPL $1.00 @ 324.389900, TRIN $2.00 @ 17.399900, ASML $2.00 @ 1739.506300, IRDM $2.00 @ 46.669900). They are prior-allocation / same-day top-up context ONLY for the 3:20 afternoon run; NEVER midday scheduled evidence, never proof the 12:30 scheduled task ran, and never counted in scheduled reliability, fill counts, slippage, cost basis, or watchdog confirmation. See config/scheduled_tasks.json:midday_dca_manual_recovery_2026_07_20.
artifact_paths.separation_note: The midday stream writes ONLY under its own root (scheduled runs plus manual override reruns under manual_reruns/). It never writes into the morning roots, /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/ce16ba6b/**, updates latest_scheduled_run.json, or touches afternoon scheduled_runs/ folders.

manual_override_run_classification.note: Manual override reruns are a MANUAL invocation of the midday live executor on account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER> (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, run_type stays 'midday_dca_live', non-scheduled run_id). They validate against schemas/midday_run_classification.schema.json's manual branch. EXCLUDED from all scheduled metrics; used ONLY as prior-allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard. Example fills (2026-07-09): AMZN $3.00 at avg fill 242.1099; GOOG $4.50 at 352.1778; GOOGL $4.50 at 354.9800.

A midday run_state has stream='midday' and valid_afternoon_evidence=false; any consumer must exclude it from afternoon scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics.
The midday stream does not update latest_scheduled_run.json or write into afternoon scheduled/manual folders.

Midday fills count only as PRIOR-ALLOCATION CONTEXT for the afternoon same-day top-up guard; they are never afternoon scheduled evidence, slippage, watchdog confirmation, scheduled cost basis, or scheduled fill counts.
Morning/manual fills count only as PRIOR-ALLOCATION CONTEXT for the midday same-day top-up guard.

Manual override reruns under /home/user/workspace/cron_tracking/midday_dca/manual_reruns/**/run_state.json and filled_orders.csv are EXCLUDED from every scheduled metric (evidence, slippage, reliability, fill counts, cost basis) and are used ONLY as prior-allocation context for the afternoon same-day top-up guard.
